content.user_title: Find Xiaohongshu Topics From Current Trends
content.value_statement: Current trend lists alone do not show which topics fit your audience. This skill combines SocialDataX trend signals and public note samples into practical editorial choices.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current Xiaohongshu hot-search signals through the SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tool.
Search public notes by keyword with sorting, content-type filters, publication-time filters, and bounded pagination.
Build three to seven topic candidates with target audiences, use scenarios, and selection reasons.
Summarize returned note titles, authors, engagement metrics, publication times, source links, and identifiers when available.
Extract title hooks and content angles, identify unsuitable trends, and recommend follow-up searches.
Handle partial results with continuation tokens while preserving cumulative page and item limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance; direct CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm.
Analysis covers only the current trend list and returned search pages, not the entire platform or complete historical trends.
Does not log in, publish posts, like, comment, modify accounts, or guarantee traffic outcomes.
Source instructions use an unpinned npm package and require token-bearing note links; review execution permissions and sharing destinations before use.

use_cases.title: Plan Creator Topics
use_cases.description: Compare current trends with relevant note samples to choose audience-specific topics and title hooks.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Brand Relevance
use_cases.description: Filter trend candidates for product relevance, audience fit, and supporting public examples before selecting a campaign angle.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Editorial Meeting
use_cases.description: Compile a structured brief with trend signals, topic candidates, sample evidence, rejected directions, and next research steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current Xiaohongshu hot-search list for [audience]. Summarize relevant signals and possible directions. Mark missing data explicitly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect current trends before choosing a research direction.

prompt_templates.title: Explore One Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for [keyword]. Review up to 20 notes across two pages, sorted by likes. Suggest three audience-specific topics with supporting examples.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: develop a focused keyword into an evidence-backed shortlist.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Filtered Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] for [audience] using video notes from the past week. Limit collection to two pages and 20 items. Compare hooks and weak directions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow research by audience, format, and publication window.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Editorial Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Review trends for [brand]. Select three keywords. Search each within the past seven days, capped at two pages and 20 notes. Build five topic candidates. Include evidence, rejected directions, and next steps. Label partial results and preserve cumulative limits when resuming.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple searches with explicit limits and recovery rules.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: review current trends for beginner home cooks.
output: Illustrative format only; no live search was performed for this example.
Trend signal: include the returned topic, rank, and available heat indicator; mark absent fields as unavailable.
Candidate direction: beginner meal preparation, subject to relevance in the returned trend list.
Next step: search the selected trend keyword for supporting public note samples.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: compare recent public notes about compact home storage.
output: Illustrative format only; no live search was performed for this example.
Sample evidence: record returned titles, authors, engagement metrics, publication dates, source references, and note identifiers.
Candidate angle: storage choices for renters with limited space; validate this direction against the retrieved samples.
Coverage note: conclusions apply only to the returned pages; missing metrics remain unavailable.
Follow-up: refine the keyword by room type or audience if the samples are too broad.

best_practices: Specify your audience and goal, then research one to three relevant trend keywords with explicit page and item limits.
Separate returned facts from editorial suggestions, mark missing fields, and label partial results before drawing conclusions.
Approve dependency execution, isolate the API credential, and review token-bearing links before sharing outputs.
anti_patterns: Treating a small sample or the current trend list as complete platform coverage or proof of future performance.
Inventing engagement metrics, publication dates, trend rankings, or missing source fields.
Automatically restarting partial searches from page one or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.

faq.question: What must I configure before using this skill?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure sufficient service balance. Direct CLI use requires Node.js, npm, network access, and permission to execute dependencies.

faq.question: Can I use MCP instead of the CLI?
faq.answer: Yes, if your agent already provides xhs_get_search_hot_list and xhs_search_notes. The skill documents their argument names and pagination rules.

faq.question: Does this skill publish or modify my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow only reads public trend and search data. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Does the analysis cover all Xiaohongshu posts?
faq.answer: No. Conclusions are limited to the current trend list and retrieved pages. Recent-day filters do not guarantee complete coverage.

faq.question: What happens when an API request fails?
faq.answer: Ordinary API failures allow one retry. Insufficient balance stops retries. Partial results require continuation tokens and remaining page and item limits.

faq.question: What should I review before sharing results?
faq.answer: Review note URLs for xsec_token. The source requires preserving it, so restrict sharing and storage until token sensitivity and recipient authorization are established.
